deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 (same for international applicants).
deadline.quote: Completed applications are due by 1 December 2026 (EST).

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is optional and does not count against you if not sent.
gre_subject.quote: (Optional) GRE General and Physics Subject Test Scores are optional

gre_general.quote: (Optional) GRE General and Physics Subject Test Scores are optional

supervisor.value: Applicants select three faculty of interest in the application; no advance agreement is mentioned.

funding.value: The department funds all PhD students for six years (including summers) through TA/RA posts or fellowships, subject to satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: For decades, the Department has been able to provide funding for all graduate students through degree. | the Department will continue the tradition of providing continuous financial support through six years of study (including summers), contingent on satisfactory progress toward the Ph.D. degree

entry_route.value: Apply straight from a B.S. in astronomy or physics; an M.S. is not needed and the department admits PhD students only.
entry_route.quote: You do not need an M.S. degree to apply for the Ph.D. program.

fee_waiver.value: Applicants not eligible for Graduate School waivers can ask the Graduate Entrance Committee chair whether the department will cover the fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants who are not eligible for these waivers may contact the chair of the Graduate Entrance Committee to discuss whether the department can cover the application fee.

notes: Applicants name three tenured/tenure-track faculty of interest and submit a 1-2 page research description.
